{{Quote|Welcome to Tosste.|Darth Sidious to Darth Maul|<ref name="TWoDM" />}}
'''Tosste''' was a uninhabited rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I see rocks, Master Sidious.|Darth Maul, to Darth Sidious|<ref name="TWoDM" />}}
Tosste was a small planet,<ref name="TWoDM" /> located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Tosste was a dead world made of wide flat lands of rocks. It was made up of a giant ocean at one point but then the landscape turned to rock.<ref name="TWoDM" />

==History==
{{Quote|Take a good look. We are standing upon what was once the bottom of an ocean. If it ever had a name, that name was lost to time many eons ago. Here, the only historic records are the geographic evidence. It's hard to believe that Tosste was once home to billions of lifeforms. While life on other worlds evolved and reached for the stars, Tosste's inhabitants were never so inspired. They stayed here. They died here. And what is their legacy? Nothing but fossils. To live without leaving a mark is a terrible thing. To die forgotten is even worse. It is... irresponsible.|Darth Sidious, to Darth Maul|<ref name="TWoDM" />}}
Tosste was once an inhabited world until all life forms disappeared.<ref name="TWoDM" />

It was on Tosste that a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]] was introduced to [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] by his master [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who also demonstrated its offensive and destructive power, by flinging rocks at the young boy and [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] lifting two boulders and smashing them together.<ref name="TWoDM" />

The Tosste system was under control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The planet was the site of a [[Battle of Tosste/Legends|battle]] of the [[Western Reaches Operation]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Reconquest of the Rim]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] defeated [[Guun Cutlax]] and the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
